parameters.formDescription: Draft and send a quotation for an inspected lead

parameters.query:
insert into public.quotes (quote_no, reference_id, business_name, contact_person, whatsapp_number, service_type, line_items, amount, advance_percent, advance_amount, validity_days, terms, status)
select $1, i.reference_id, i.business_name, i.contact_person, i.whatsapp_number, i.selected_service, $3, $4::int, $5::int, ($4::int * $5::int / 100), $6::int, $7, 'sent'
from public.inspections i
where i.reference_id = $2
returning quote_no, reference_id, business_name, contact_person, whatsapp_number, service_type, amount, advance_percent, advance_amount, validity_days;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Parse Create Form').item.json.quoteNo, $('Parse Create Form').item.json.referenceId, $('Parse Create Form').item.json.lineItems, $('Parse Create Form').item.json.amount, $('Parse Create Form').item.json.advancePercent, $('Parse Create Form').item.json.validityDays, $('Parse Create Form').item.json.terms ] }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: "whatsapp", recipient_type: "individual", to: "91" + $('Insert Quote').item.json.whatsapp_number, type: "template", template: { name: "osmida_quote", language: { code: "en" }, components: [ { type: "body", parameters: [ { type: "text", text: $('Insert Quote').item.json.business_name || 'Customer' }, { type: "text", text: $('Insert Quote').item.json.service_type || 'Service' }, { type: "text", text: $('Insert Quote').item.json.reference_id || '' }, { type: "text", text: 'Rs ' + String($('Insert Quote').item.json.amount || 0) } ] } ] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: "917981067780", type: "text", text: { body: "QUOTE SENT

Quote: " + $('Insert Quote').item.json.quote_no + "
Ref: " + $('Insert Quote').item.json.reference_id + "
Business: " + $('Insert Quote').item.json.business_name + "
Amount: Rs " + $('Insert Quote').item.json.amount } }) }}

parameters.completionMessage: The quotation has been saved and sent to the customer via WhatsApp.

parameters.formDescription: Record whether a quote was won or lost

parameters.query:
update public.quotes
set status = $1,
    amount = case when $3::int > 0 then $3::int else amount end,
    updated_at = now()
where reference_id = $2
returning quote_no, reference_id, amount, status;

insert into public.bookings (
  reference_id, customer_name, contact_person, phone, whatsapp_number, business_name,
  facility_type, service_type, selected_service, service_price, preferred_date, inspection_date,
  time_slot, address, site_address, locality, floor_area, notes, service_urgency,
  main_pest_issue, pest_premises_type, approximate_size, pest_details, kitchen_details,
  washroom_details, contact_consent, status
)
select
  i.reference_id, i.business_name, i.contact_person, i.whatsapp_number, i.whatsapp_number, i.business_name,
  i.facility_type, i.selected_service, i.selected_service,
  coalesce(nullif($2::int, 0), (select q.amount from public.quotes q where q.reference_id = i.reference_id order by q.created_at desc limit 1), 0), 
  i.inspection_date, i.inspection_date,
  coalesce(i.time_slot, 'TBD'), i.site_address, i.site_address, i.locality, i.floor_area, i.notes, i.service_urgency,
  i.main_pest_issue, i.pest_premises_type, i.approximate_size, i.pest_details, i.kitchen_details,
  i.washroom_details, i.contact_consent, 'confirmed'
from public.inspections i
where i.reference_id = $1
returning id, reference_id, business_name, whatsapp_number, selected_service, service_price;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: "whatsapp", recipient_type: "individual", to: "91" + $('Create Booking').item.json.whatsapp_number, type: "template", template: { name: "osmida_advance", language: { code: "en" }, components: [ { type: "body", parameters: [ { type: "text", text: $('Create Booking').item.json.business_name || 'Customer' }, { type: "text", text: $('Create Booking').item.json.reference_id || '' }, { type: "text", text: $('Create Booking').item.json.selected_service || 'Service' }, { type: "text", text: 'Rs ' + String(Math.round(($('Create Booking').item.json.service_price || 0) * 0.5) || $('Create Booking').item.json.service_price || 0) }, { type: "text", text: $('Parse Decision').item.json.upiId || 'call +917676358162' } ] } ] } }) }}
